Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, February 6, 2019 12:13 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Cc: Sulonen, Dana <DSulonen@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Next week 
 
Anthony: What’s the ETA on your story.
If we don’t have it ASAP, we’ll have to punt.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Sunday, February 3, 2019 4:36 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Cc: Sulonen, Dana <DSulonen@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Next week
These dates work for me. I will get you in touch with Rick, who was photographing the event, and Mark, who was shooting video, for art and multimedia.

I talked to Kyle Funkhouser but I don't think it's strong enough for a solo feature. My plan is to give one last dose of reality on the Tigers' rebuilding situation before spring training hits, about how this likely will take longer - perhaps much longer - than anyone expects. Plan for 25 inches on it.

From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Saturday, February 2, 2019 7:03:05 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Cc: Sulonen, Dana
Subject: Next week
Anthony: I’m looking at running your fantasy camp story for Thursday. I’ll need art and I’ll need it filed by early Wednesday morning.

For Sunday, my plan is to run your spring training preview. I’d like that to include something meaty on prospects … but if there’s another decent story that you gathered while in Florida, we can consider that. Whatever it is will run as my CP. So PLEASE MAKE SURE I’M IN THE LOOP.
In addition to the mainbar, I’d like you to do some listicles:
-3 dark horses who could make the roster
Any other ideas? Let me know.
I want the spring training content done by FRIDAY AT NOON.
These are hard deadlines. If I don’t get them by then, I’ll have to make other plans for Sunday.

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, June 7, 2018 5:50 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Sipple, George <gsipple@freepress.com>
Subject: Next week 
 
Guys: Thanks for all the work scrambling with things that were either tangent or unrelated to your day-to-day work you’ve been doing on the Tigers beat.
It’s appreciated more than you know.
Next week: Let’s get back on schedule with the observations, mailbags and mini-enterprise things. Figured that was the plan, but since it’s been a bit hectic of late, I figured I’d send the reminder.
